ambient_definitions.basis: QuantumBlockEncoding.PrimitiveBasis N is the type Fin N → Fin 2 of binary strings with wire coordinates from Fin N.
ambient_definitions.ccx: QuantumBlockEncoding.ccxBasisAction c₀ c₁ t b := if b c₀ = 1 ∧ b c₁ = 1 then QuantumBlockEncoding.xBasisAction t b else b.
ambient_definitions.cx: QuantumBlockEncoding.cxBasisAction c t b := if b c = 0 then b else QuantumBlockEncoding.xBasisAction t b.
ambient_definitions.injective: Function.Injective f means ∀ ⦃a b⦄, f a = f b → a = b.
ambient_definitions.involutive: Function.Involutive f means ∀ x, f (f x) = x.
ambient_definitions.x: QuantumBlockEncoding.xBasisAction t b := Function.update b t (QuantumBlockEncoding.flipBit (b t)); flipBit z := if z = 0 then 1 else 0.

formal_context.target: (∀ (N : ℕ) (c₀ c₁ t : Fin N), c₀ ≠ t → c₁ ≠ t → Function.Involutive (QuantumBlockEncoding.ccxBasisAction c₀ c₁ t)) ∧ (∀ (N : ℕ) (c t : Fin N), c ≠ t → QuantumBlockEncoding.ccxBasisAction c c t = QuantumBlockEncoding.cxBasisAction c t)
